article.title: TRAI floats a consultation paper on satellite spectrum pricing methodology
article.text: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India released a consultation paper seeking views on the pricing methodology for satellite communication spectrum, covering whether administrative assignment should carry a percentage-of-revenue levy and how any such levy should interact with the existing licence fee framework. Responses are due in eight weeks and the authority will hold an open house before framing recommendations, which the department of telecommunications is not bound to accept. No band, quantum, reserve price or timeline is proposed in the paper. Terrestrial mobile operators hold no satellite spectrum today and the incumbent satellite licensees are unlisted or foreign-owned subsidiaries.
article.note: A consultation paper is not a policy. Every quantity that would make a company claim measurable is explicitly absent -- the correct answer is that nothing is material enough to publish.

shocks.label: Satellite spectrum pricing consultation
shocks.mechanism: A consultation on assignment methodology may eventually change the cost basis of satellite spectrum, but no band, quantum or reserve price has been proposed

edges.mechanism: Any eventual levy framework would apply to licensees holding satellite spectrum

companies.name: Bharti Airtel
companies.mechanism: A future revenue-share levy on satellite spectrum would raise the cost basis of any satellite broadband venture the operator eventually pursues through an affiliate
companies.rationale: Has publicly stated an intention to pursue satellite broadband at some future date

companies.name: Vodafone Idea
companies.mechanism: Any additional spectrum-linked levy framework adds to the regulatory cost stack a leveraged operator must eventually fund
companies.rationale: Balance sheet leaves no headroom for incremental regulatory cost of any kind

ground_truth.rationale: ABSTENTION FIXTURE. Weak exposure to a real regulatory process is still weak exposure: neither operator holds the spectrum being priced, the paper proposes no quantum, and the evidence is pure model inference. A LOW composite materiality grade must exclude rather than earn a quiet deep-dive slot.
